# EEVSEC CyberRange

> A competitive, live-fire cybersecurity training arena: real-time PvP battles on isolated virtual machines, a state-aware AI Coach, and deep attack/defense simulations. Visitors can request access on the CyberRange site. Operated by EEVSEC PRIVATE LIMITED (Ahmedabad, India).

## Core
- [How it works](https://eevsec.com/cyberrange/#how): Two players enter one live scenario, one attacks and one defends, across isolated virtual machines.
- [AI Coach](https://eevsec.com/cyberrange/#coach): Side-aware, in-match guidance that tracks your actions and explains the next move; each side's session is private.
- [Modes](https://eevsec.com/cyberrange/#modes): Battle, Practice, Learn, and Analyze.
- [Scenarios](https://eevsec.com/cyberrange/#scenarios): IoT & semiconductor, digital forensics, cloud & zero-trust, adversarial AI, red/blue automation, and SCADA/ICS.
- [Doctrine](https://eevsec.com/cyberrange/doctrine): Every scenario runs on three layers — WAR (strategy), Ethical Hacking (craft), and Cyber Crime (the real-world threat).

## Company

- [Privacy Policy](https://eevsec.com/cyberrange/privacy): Data processing under DPDPA 2023, UAE PDPL, CCPA, and GDPR.
- [Terms of Service](https://eevsec.com/cyberrange/terms): Rules of engagement, liability limits, and governing law.
- [Acceptable Use Policy](https://eevsec.com/cyberrange/aup): Sandbox isolation, no off-platform misuse, and the rules of engagement (incorporated into the Terms).
- [Refund Policy](https://eevsec.com/cyberrange/returns): Subscription, cancellation, and refund rules.
- [Security & Responsible Disclosure](https://eevsec.com/cyberrange/security): How to report a vulnerability; see also /.well-known/security.txt.
